title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — 適用範囲と対象事業者
text: Summary: 2024 AI事業者ガイドライン applies to developers, providers, and users of AI systems in Japan. It emphasises lifecycle governance, accountability, and risk-based internal controls rather than binding statutory obligations.

title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — ライフサイクル管理
text: Summary: The guideline requires organisations to implement governance across the AI lifecycle including design, development, deployment, operation, monitoring, and termination. Risk identification and mitigation should be continuous.

title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — リスクベースアプローチ
text: Summary: Organisations should adopt a risk-based approach proportionate to impact and scale. Higher-risk use cases require stronger oversight, documentation, and testing.

title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — 透明性と説明責任
text: Summary: AI providers should provide appropriate transparency regarding system purpose, limitations, and risks. Explanations should be understandable to affected stakeholders.

title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — 人間による監督
text: Summary: Human oversight should be ensured especially where AI outputs may affect rights or interests. Organisations must define escalation and override processes.

title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — セキュリティ対策
text: Summary: Security measures must address risks such as data leakage, adversarial attacks, and misuse. Organisations should implement technical and organisational safeguards.

title: AI事業者ガイドライン2024 — 継続的モニタリング
text: Summary: Continuous monitoring of model behaviour, performance degradation, and unexpected outputs is required. Feedback loops and corrective action processes should be established.

title: 個人情報保護法（APPI）— 個人情報の定義
text: Summary: APPI defines personal information broadly. If an AI system processes identifiable information, the operator is subject to statutory obligations under the Act.

title: APPI — 越境移転
text: Summary: Cross-border transfer of personal data requires safeguards. When AI services store or process data overseas, compliance measures must be implemented.

title: APPI — 利用目的の特定と制限
text: Summary: Organisations must specify the purpose of data use and not exceed it. Using personal data for AI training may require compatibility analysis.

title: PPC — AI利用に関する留意点
text: Summary: PPC guidance highlights risks of unintended secondary use, data scraping, and insufficient transparency in AI deployments.

title: 内閣府 AI戦略
text: Summary: Japan’s AI Strategy emphasises innovation, international alignment, and responsible AI deployment while avoiding heavy ex-ante regulation.

title: 生成AIに関するガバナンスの考え方
text: Summary: For generative AI, organisations should consider hallucination risk, harmful content generation, and prompt injection as governance risks requiring mitigation.

title: 生成AI — プロンプトインジェクション対策
text: Summary: Prompt injection risks require input validation, content filtering, and system boundary controls to prevent data leakage or instruction override.

title: 生成AI — データ漏えい対策
text: Summary: Organisations must prevent confidential or personal information from being exposed through model outputs. Logging, filtering, and access control should be implemented.
